title: SHEIN Black Friday 2026: when it starts, what SHEIN has announced and how the 4CW5Y code works

description: Black Friday 2026 is November 27. In the US, SHEIN announced a Year-End Sale without dates; other countries differ. US calendar, coupons, points, returns and 4CW5Y.

contentSections.heading: Quick answer
paragraphs: Black Friday 2026 falls on November 27. SHEIN's US Year-End Sale announcement includes Black Friday and Cyber Monday offers without campaign dates. Search referral code 4CW5Y in the SHEIN app or on the website to open a selection with promotions and discounts; SHEIN sets the eligible items and savings.

contentSections.heading: When SHEIN's Black Friday starts
paragraphs: The calendar Black Friday is the last Friday of November, the 27th in 2026, and Cyber Monday is the 30th. Those dates do not say when SHEIN starts or ends its deals. In the US, SHEIN announced its [Year-End Sale](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/shein-kicks-off-holiday-shopping-season-with-its-biggest-black-friday--cyber-monday-selection-yet-302914580.html) on October 20, with Black Friday and Cyber Monday deals; the release gives no dates or percentage.

Outside the US, campaigns, dates and discounts change by country, and we found no official calendar for other English-speaking countries: check the campaign on your country's SHEIN site or app. The table shows what SHEIN announced for the US store.

postParagraphs: In 2023, 2024 and 2025, the US announcements extended offers into December. These are historical announcements, not dates for 2026. Compare the final price of the item you want; a campaign maximum does not guarantee its price will fall.

contentSections.heading: The advertised discount and your final price

image.alt: Cecília Mauad in two looks from a SHEIN haul: a light blouse tied at the waist with a black midi skirt, and a long black dress with light cut-outs

paragraphs: An advertised maximum discount applies to eligible items. Check whether the product you want is included and compare its final price:
bullets: Save the items to your wishlist and note today's price before deciding when to buy.
Compare the wishlist price with the later phases.
Look at the final price in the cart, with shipping and taxes, and not only the percentage in the announcement.
If the item comes in a hard-to-find size, don't wait for the last phase: stock may run out first.

contentSections.heading: Coupons, points and the 4CW5Y code
paragraphs: Under SHEIN's coupon policy, one platform coupon applies per order. Each coupon has an expiry date, and one not used in time becomes unavailable.
The checkout shows how many SHEIN points you can use and the discount they provide. Check that amount before paying.

4CW5Y is not a coupon: it is Cecília's SHEIN referral code, and it does give you a discount. Open SHEIN through Cecília's link and search 4CW5Y in the SHEIN app or on the site: the code opens a page with a selection of recommended products, promotions and discounts. How much and on which items is up to SHEIN and varies. SHEIN campaigns change all the time: check the current ones on the store page here on the site before placing your order.

contentSections.heading: Exchanges and returns after Black Friday
bullets: **Before you buy:** check the return policy for your order, including the deadline, eligible items and return costs.
**Partial returns:** check how the refund is calculated when a coupon or promotion was used.
**Taxes:** consult the refund terms for your order and destination.

contentSections.heading: Before you pay: what to check
bullets: Whether the coupon went through and the points were applied.
The delivery time, if the purchase is a Christmas present.
The return deadline, eligible items and return costs for your order.
paragraphs: **Shipping:** check the delivery charge for your address and the conditions of any free shipping offer in the cart.

contentSections.heading: Frequently asked questions
bullets: When does SHEIN's Black Friday start and how long does it last? Black Friday 2026 falls on November 27. SHEIN's US Year-End Sale release includes seasonal offers but does not specify campaign dates. Check the campaign displayed in the store before buying.
How does SHEIN's Black Friday work? Offers may have different dates and conditions. Check which items qualify for the advertised discount and compare the final price in the cart.

Does SHEIN have Cyber Monday? Cyber Monday 2026 falls on November 30. SHEIN's 2026 US release includes Cyber Monday deals, without dates. For other countries, we found no announcement: check the campaign on your country's SHEIN site.
Will a Black Friday order arrive before Christmas? We can't guarantee a date. The delivery estimate appears in your order before you pay: check it on every purchase.

Is 4CW5Y a discount coupon? It is not a coupon, but it does give you a discount: it is Cecília's SHEIN referral code. Open SHEIN through the link and search for the code in the app or on the site: the code opens a selection of products with promotions and discounts; how much and on which items is up to SHEIN.
